historical_commentary.text: This note introduces Object Libraries, a new-in-2004 mechanism for storing reusable objects directly inside a 4D database's binary structure without needing the separate 4D Insider tool. This was an early step toward modularizing structure-file content, foreshadowing (though very different from) the later component and Project Mode architectures. The specific Object Library mechanism belongs to the binary Design Mode era and has been superseded by 4D's modern component system and Project Mode's plain-text, filesystem-based structure organization. Only the teaser paragraph could be recovered for this note.
related_updates: 4D's component architecture and Project Mode (v17, 2018) now provide far more capable ways to package and reuse structure elements than binary Object Libraries
4D Insider itself is no longer part of the modern 4D product line
